head: expect/actual
is the wrong
default
body: Every KMP tutorial teaches it first. Then people use it for everything, and the shared code turns into a knot.

head: Cast by name.
*No swapping.
slides.caption: A stand-in cast at compile time, on stage every night. Perfect for a small fixed role. Useless when the part needs to change, because you cannot swap an understudy mid-run.

head: An interface in common,
injected per platform
code: actual fun copy(text: String) { /* android impl */ }

items.title: Varies, or needs a fake
items.sub: interface in common, inject the platform impl

items.title: Ask: can I test this?
items.sub: you cannot inject a fake into a weld

items.title: Ask: will there be two?
items.sub: an understudy plays exactly one role

head: Reach for the tool
that keeps your
*options open
body: Interfaces and injection compose, and they test. expect/actual welds.
Use the weld only where you genuinely want one permanent joint.
